description: Stonewright prompt library: outcome-oriented starters for MCP clients. Prefer stonewright-task-start; do not paste full prompts into task-start responses.

prompts.title: Inspect site snapshot
prompts.summary: Capture a compact operational overview before changing anything.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright on this WordPress site. Call stonewright-task-start first. Then run stonewright-site-snapshot and stonewright-content-inventory. Summarize name, theme, plugin counts, post counts, mode, MCP surface, and the top content types. Do not mutate the site.
prompts.verification: Response includes mode, mcp_surface, and at least post/page counts without write tools.

prompts.title: Repair from site pulse
prompts.summary: Score hardening/performance and apply the top safe fixes.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Start with stonewright-task-start, then stonewright-site-pulse. For each failed high/critical check, propose a concrete repair. Apply only reversible fixes through typed abilities (stonewright-settings-update, stonewright-wp-cli-run, stonewright-site-health-test) after confirming mode; skip production-safe destructive steps without tokens. Do not use stonewright-php-execute for routine pulse repairs.
prompts.verification: Pulse score and fixes list present; any writes audited; no confirmation_token skipped in production-safe.

prompts.title: Elementor landing page from brief
prompts.summary: Build a new Elementor landing page with native widgets first.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start. Plan with stonewright-design-native-plan, validate the DesignSpec, snapshot, then build with stonewright-elementor-v3-build-page-from-spec. Polish with stonewright-elementor-v3-batch-mutate. Prefer native Elementor widgets. Verify desktop/tablet/mobile with no horizontal overflow.
prompts.verification: Page has Elementor data; digest shows structure; no raw HTML widget dump for core sections.

prompts.title: Elementor section refactor
prompts.summary: Refactor one hero/section with backup and batch mutate.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright on page {{post_id}}. Start with stonewright-task-start, read stonewright-elementor-page-digest, snapshot via backup, then batch-mutate only the hero section for clearer hierarchy and spacing. Leave other sections untouched.
prompts.verification: Backup snapshot id recorded; only targeted elements changed; digest before/after differs in hero only.

prompts.title: Gutenberg homepage hero
prompts.summary: Update a block-theme homepage hero without breaking brand tokens.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start. Read the homepage template and current hero blocks with stonewright-blocks-parse. Snapshot before writes. Update the hero for stronger headline, CTA, and mobile spacing while preserving theme.json tokens. Verify desktop and mobile.
prompts.verification: Template/post updated; theme.json tokens unchanged unless explicitly requested.

prompts.title: FSE footer cleanup
prompts.summary: Clean footer template part structure.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Start with stonewright-task-start. Read the footer template part, snapshot, then simplify navigation/social rows for accessibility and consistent spacing. Do not invent brand colors outside theme.json.
prompts.verification: Footer part saves; no horizontal overflow at 390px width.

prompts.title: Services CPT + fields
prompts.summary: Register a Services model and seed sample rows.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start. Create a Services content model with fields for icon, headline, summary, proof metric, and CTA. Seed six service rows with bulk upsert. Finish with content-inventory to confirm counts.
prompts.verification: CPT visible in inventory; six seeded posts; REST base documented.

prompts.title: Stock image fill for hero
prompts.summary: Search Openverse/stock, import, attach alt text.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Start with stonewright-task-start. Search stock images with stonewright-stock-image-search for the homepage hero brief, import the best licensed result with stonewright-stock-image-import, set meaningful alt text, and report the attachment id for the page builder to use.
prompts.verification: Attachment id returned; alt non-empty; license/source noted when available.

prompts.title: On-page SEO meta pass
prompts.summary: Inspect and update SEO meta for key pages.
prerequisites: SEO plugin with REST or Stonewright SEO adapters
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start and stonewright-seo-status. For the homepage and top three service pages, get meta, tighten titles/descriptions to intent, update, and report before/after strings.
prompts.verification: Meta updated only on listed ids; titles ≤ ~60 chars; no keyword stuffing.

prompts.title: WP-CLI cache and rewrite health
prompts.summary: Tokenized WP-CLI status, rewrite flush when safe.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright companion WP-CLI tools only (never shell wp). Call stonewright-task-start, wp-cli-status, discover rewrite/cache commands, then run a safe status check. Flush rewrites only if the operator confirmed staging.
prompts.verification: All WP-CLI calls tokenized; no eval/shell; output includes command results without secrets.

prompts.title: Figma to native pixel-perfect build
prompts.summary: External Figma MCP to evidence to native plan to verify.
prerequisites: External Figma MCP tools in the client (official and/or console-bridge)
design-to-wordpress skill references/figma-mcp-extraction.md for field-to-tool map
Browser/Playwright MCP for post-write measured_targets verification
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start. List MCP tools and extract design with the client's external Figma MCP (console-bridge preferred when present: figma_export_tokens / figma_get_variables / deep component trees; official: get_variable_defs, get_design_context, get_metadata, get_screenshot). Map fields via skills/design-to-wordpress/references/figma-mcp-extraction.md. Normalize into DesignEvidence/figma_token_table (never embed Figma APIs inside Stonewright; no raw Figma tree after normalization). Call stonewright-design-native-plan. Render with the user-chosen engine (elementor|gutenberg|fse). CSS only when native_gap is recorded. Verify each breakpoint with the client's own browser tools against evidence targets (±2px spacing).
prompts.verification: Native plan present; native_gap for any CSS; no raw Figma tree after normalization; provenance set on measured values; verification notes per breakpoint.

prompts.title: Upgrade tool profile mid-session
prompts.summary: When a needed tool is missing, activate a broader profile and re-list.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start. If a required tool is missing from the list, call stonewright-tool-profile with action=activate and profile=full (or the matching specialist profile), then re-list tools (tools/list) before continuing. When the client cannot hold the full catalog, use the compact discover-execute path: stonewright-discover-abilities → stonewright-get-ability-info → stonewright-execute-ability (php-execute stays off that profile). Do not invent shell or REST workarounds.
prompts.verification: tool-profile returns tools_changed/re_list_instruction when applicable; subsequent tools/list includes the needed tool.

prompts.title: WooCommerce catalog inspection or guarded update
prompts.summary: Use native catalog abilities in Plugin mode or read-only store tools in Direct mode.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright and call stonewright-task-start first. Inspect the returned mode. In Plugin mode, call stonewright-wc-status and stonewright-wc-catalog-audit, then use native wc product, variation, attribute, and term abilities with dry_run:true before any approved write; read back exact fields after apply. In Direct mode, use only stonewright-wc-product-list, stonewright-wc-order-list, and stonewright-wc-sales-report; do not attempt catalog writes. Never change payments, checkout, taxes, or live order state unless the user explicitly expands scope.
prompts.verification: Mode reported; Plugin writes have dry-run, permission, audit, confirmation when required, and readback receipts; Direct remains read-only.

prompts.title: Direct mode safe site inspection
prompts.summary: Use the pluginless companion without degrading to ad-hoc REST or shell workarounds.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright Direct mode. Call stonewright-task-start first, then stonewright-site-capabilities. Report active Direct capabilities, write mode, matched local skills, memory references, and recurring errors. Inspect content with stonewright-content-inventory and WooCommerce with stonewright-wc-product-list only through typed read tools. Do not install the plugin, use shell WP-CLI, or create REST runner scripts unless I explicitly request a mode change.
prompts.verification: task-start reports Direct mode; no write occurs; no credential, absolute state path, or private sites.json content appears in output.

prompts.title: Update and verify Stonewright
prompts.summary: Match the plugin and companion versions, reload the client, and prove the live tool surface.
prompts.prompt: Help me update Stonewright without exposing credentials. Determine whether this setup uses Plugin mode, Direct mode, local stdio, or remote HTTP. Plugin mode: update the WordPress ZIP through the native updater. Local stdio or Direct: update the pinned companion release tarball separately. Remote HTTP: no local companion update is required. After the user restarts the MCP client, call stonewright-task-start, stonewright-ping, stonewright-site-info, and stonewright-tool-profile. When the companion is local, also call stonewright-setup-profile, stonewright-wordpress-mcp-status, and stonewright-client-surface-check. Confirm plugin version where applicable, companion_version where applicable, expected_companion_package, startup_ready, and an empty refresh_required_tool_names list. Never inspect or print private client config.
prompts.verification: Live mode and versions match the selected release; startup_ready is true; required tool list is complete; persistent memory, skills, and audit were not reset.

prompts.title: Elementor transactional repair
prompts.summary: Batch mutate under transaction envelope with rollback.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start. Digest the page, then stonewright-elementor-v3-transaction-run with stop_on_error and rollback_on_error. Prefer native widgets. If readback fails, confirm automatic rollback and report snapshot id.
prompts.verification: Transaction result ok or rolled_back with snapshot; no partial silent failure.

prompts.title: Fix my connection
prompts.summary: Diagnose MCP connection, alias, profile, and tool-surface mismatches without exposing secrets.
prerequisites: Ability to restart the MCP client
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start first. If the client cannot reach WordPress, run stonewright-ping and stonewright-site-info, then follow the Troubleshoot flow from Stonewright > Setup (or the companion connect verify/repair path for local stdio). Confirm the active alias, configured_mode, active_mode, companion_version, and that stonewright-task-start appears in tools/list after restart. If tools are truncated, call stonewright-tool-profile activate with the matching profile and re-list tools. Never print Application Passwords, OAuth tokens, or private client config.
prompts.verification: Connection mode and alias reported; task-start visible after restart; no credentials or private config in output.

prompts.title: Build a section on my block theme
prompts.summary: Queue block changes through the Block Editor Queue finalizer instead of hand-editing serialized HTML.
prerequisites: Block Editor Queue tab reachable in wp-admin
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start. Read the target template or page with stonewright-blocks-parse, then stonewright-blocks-finalizer-runtime to confirm the Block Editor Queue is online. Queue one section change with stonewright-blocks-queue-change, complete the browser finalizer step, and persist with stonewright-blocks-finalize-batch after snapshot. Preserve theme.json tokens unless I explicitly request brand changes. Verify desktop and mobile.
prompts.verification: Finalizer runtime online; queued change finalized with readback; section renders without horizontal overflow at 390px.

prompts.title: Audit Elementor performance
prompts.summary: Measure document, settings, backup, and revision size without exposing content.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start, then stonewright-elementor-performance-audit for page {{post_id}}. Summarize bounded size metrics, backup/revision debt, and the top three remediation steps. Use stonewright-elementor-page-digest only if structure context is needed. Do not mutate the document unless I explicitly expand scope.
prompts.verification: Performance audit metrics returned; remediation list is actionable; no raw _elementor_data dump.

prompts.title: What can you do with my page builder?
prompts.summary: Report Elementor and third-party block-library capabilities available on this site.
prerequisites: At least one page builder or block library installed
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright. Call stonewright-task-start, then stonewright-site-capabilities. Report whether Elementor, Gutenberg/FSE, GenerateBlocks, Kadence, Spectra, or Blocksy is active. When Elementor is present, call stonewright-elementor-v3-status. When a third-party block library is active, call stonewright-blocks-library-check-setup and stonewright-blocks-library-list-blocks for that library. Summarize what I can build natively on this site without inventing widgets or block attributes.
prompts.verification: Active builders/libraries listed with version signals; no invented widget or block schemas.

prompts.title: Custom code with human approval
prompts.summary: Prepare an exact theme-file or Customizer CSS proposal and stop for a human-issued one-time grant.
prompts.prompt: Use Stonewright and call stonewright-task-start first. Prove the native gap, then run the matching approval-gated custom-code tool with dry_run:true. Return approval_url, exact path, before_bytes, after_bytes, changed_bytes, and a short change summary, then stop. Do not open the approval page, issue or retrieve the grant, or apply the candidate unless I explicitly ask you to perform that approval step. After I send the one-time custom_code_grant, apply only the exact approved hash and report backup, readback, smoke, and rollback status.
prompts.verification: No write occurs before the human-issued grant; candidate path and hash remain unchanged; apply reports verified readback and audit fields.
